summary: All executable gates pass at 895c65c8 (HEAD unchanged during the run): PROJECT_TESTS 11 files and 155 tests, owned tsc errors 0, known-red rule met, static gates 2 to 5 clean, own files outside the allowed set 0, Reviews A and B and the adversarial round have no open blocker, and no code or test file changed after the reviewed code at 91b2a1ca. The fix is a Measure-only commit; the carry-over rule of section 4.4 then allows a cheap rerun.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] phase-acceptance: Accepted Nits RA-2, RA-3, RA-4, RA-6, RA3-2, RB-4, RB-5, RB-6, RB2-2, RB2-3, and RB2-4 have no row in test-strategy.md section 8, and RA-6 has no entry in the plan note of Task 3. Rationale: the Phase 1 contract requires that every accepted Nit is recorded in section 8, and gate 7 requires that the plan note records any other prompt difference. Section 8 holds only ADV-N3 to ADV-N6, RA2-5, RB2-1, and the spec omissions (grep of the track folder for each id). The train spec l2-w07-card-train.json:11 adds the mustShow phrase 'four small wheels'. The list row and plan.md hold no such phrase. Fix: add one section 8 row for each accepted Nit with its default and owner, and add the wheels phrase as a ninth prompt difference in the plan note (or remove the phrase). Owner: the orchestrator for the strategy, and the user or a build session for plan.md. Both are Measure-only edits.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: RB2-1 (Review B, Major) has no code fix. Rationale: the in-flight cost of a paid pool is not visible to the per-call re-check. Strategy section 5.1 rule a and section 8 close it with operating rules (concurrency 1 and --tries 1 at or above 1.20 USD), and ADVC18 pins the file-only read. I accept this as non-blocking because the strategy records the decision. The Phase 2 checker must verify rules a to f, because they are the only control of this gap.

F3 [Nit] phase-acceptance: ./measure/doctor.sh (structural-only) reports 'asset_storytime_l2_cards_20261106/plan.md: in_progress track has no unchecked task'. Rationale: Tasks 1 to 3 are [x] and every remaining task is [b], and the doctor does not count [b]. The plan section 'Task markers' says the orchestrator changes [b] to [~] when a blocker clears. The error clears when the orchestrator marks the first Phase 2 task [~]. The spec acceptance criterion 'the doctor adds no error for this track' applies at closeout. The other doctor errors name other tracks.

F4 [Nit] phase-acceptance: The plan quotes '38 total' tsc errors (Task 3 amendment, Task 2 round 3 and 4 notes). Acceptance measured 37 total errors at 895c65c8 with 0 owned. Rationale: the total is informational in section 3, and the difference comes from errors outside the owned prefixes in a shared working tree. No gate reads the total. Record the measured value at closeout.

F5 [Nit] phase-acceptance: measure/runs/asset_storytime_l2_cards_20261106/mid-red-29524b0.log has an uncommitted edit (resulting_head and commits lines changed from 'pending commit' to ad9cc588), and 26 run records are untracked. Rationale: these are evidence files in the allowed run folder. The closeout commit must add them with explicit paths. No owned code, test, fixture, or spec path is dirty.

F6 [Nit] phase-acceptance: Section 4.5 says the checker reruns M1 to M7 and MF1 to MF4. This run did not rerun them. Rationale: the shell policy of this run denied the creation of a scratch mutation script. Gate 8 of section 4.2 asks only that the Green log quotes the result.
